snippet.title: The tower must fall OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
Stack modular tower pieces to create strange and unstable defences. Every run produces a different tower, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. Sometimes, designs that shouldn't work... somehow do.

Try the demo on steam today!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4483900/The_Tower_Must_Fall/

And join our discord for some private playtests!!
https://discord.gg/uPYkKKqNjk
